What is a high-frequency electric toothbrush?
High-frequency electric toothbrush vibrations are the movement of the brush head at a higher frequency than a standard electric toothbrush, and can also be referred to as sonic toothbrush or sonic toothbrush vibrate.

High frequency toothbrush vibrations can break up bacteria and plaque build up, helping the bristles reach all surfaces of your teeth and remove harmful bacteria and plaque. It can also improve blood flow to your gums.
Sonic toothbrushes are usually sold separately than regular toothbrushes, but can be a helpful addition if you are looking to further improve your oral care routine and hygiene.
